item.title: Marlyn Spaaij - Trouble in Mind - Dutch Design Daily
item.description: As Lucille joins her father on tour this summer, idealized expectations clash with reality as she is confronted with the painful truth behind his music.

item.title: Patty Stenger & Yvonne Kroese - Vleestomaat - Dutch Design Daily
item.description: Vleestomaat is a blood-curdling animation film about loneliness and fear of the unknown. Friendship cannot be forced, but sometimes it appears when you least expect it.

item.title: Sophie Olga de Jong & Sytske Kok - Hondenleven - Dutch Design Daily
item.description: When grandma's dog dies, granddaughter Luna helps with the burial. But what happens when you're dead and buried underground?

item.title: Amy Lewis - Contemporary interpretations of traditional textile crafts - Dutch Design Daily
item.description: Amy Lewis experiments with traditional textile techniques and translates them into contemporary, sensory objects. Her work combines craftsmanship, material research, and imagination.

item.title: The Weight of the Hide - Dutch Design Daily
item.description: Working with leather inevitably comes with ethical and emotional complexities. That’s why, as a leather designer, Emma Werkhoven decided to take matters into her own hands.

item.title: Jesse Paauwe - Playing with order and chaos - Dutch Design Daily
item.description: Jesse Paauwe views the world around him with a fresh, inquisitive eye. As a graphic and spatial designer, he draws inspiration from everyday situations in public spaces.

item.title: St. Parrott’s Day ‘Stamp’ - Dutch Design Daily
item.description: Post NL, the Dutch postal service, has unofficially* produced a stamp celebrating St. Patrick’s Day and Irish goalscoring sensation Troy Parrott, who plays for Dutch side AZ Alkmaar.

item.title: Tube Lamp - Dutch Design Daily
item.description: A lamp crafted using the ancient rammed earth technique within a meticulously hand-carved wooden mold.

item.title: New identity Keukenhof - Dutch Design Daily
item.description: Keukenhof is one of the world’s largest flower gardens, situated in Lisse, The Netherlands. Thonik gave both the flower garden and the adjoining castle a new identity, using the castle’s masonry as inspiration for both.

item.title: Macaron Modular Sofa - Dutch Design Daily
item.description: Macaron, designed by Mecanoo and Bert Plantagie, is not just furniture; it’s a flexible place to stay. Human-centred design for evolving activities, it adapts from focus to relaxation, work to social interaction.
